candidates.teaser: There's a moment astrologers say every single person on Earth goes through — and most people don't survive it emotionally the same way.
candidates.video_title: The Planet That Breaks You Down to Rebuild You
candidates.video_description: Saturn Return is one of astrology's most feared and respected cycles. Occurring around ages 27-30, it's said to strip away everything that no longer serves your true path. Astrologers call it your first real reckoning.
candidates.script: Every person on Earth, no matter their sign, hits the same astrological wall — and astrologers say almost no one sees it coming. Around age 27 to 30, Saturn returns to the exact position it held the moment you were born. In traditional astrology, this is described as a reckoning — everything built on the wrong foundation starts to crack. Relationships end, careers collapse, identities dissolve. But here's the twist: astrologers say it only destroys what was never really yours. How old are you right now? Comment below.

candidates.teaser: Astrologers say one specific placement in the birth chart is so intense, most people born with it spend years hiding it from everyone — including themselves.
candidates.video_title: The Darkest Placement in the Entire Birth Chart
candidates.video_description: In astrology, Scorpio on the 12th house cusp is considered one of the most hidden and psychologically complex placements. Astrologers describe it as carrying secrets even the bearer doesn't fully understand. It's power buried in silence.
candidates.script: If you have Scorpio anywhere near your 12th house, astrologers say you carry one of the most psychologically intense placements in the entire chart — and most people with it don't even know it exists. The 12th house in traditional astrology represents what's buried, hidden, even from yourself. Scorpio there is described as raw, transformative power locked behind a door you didn't know you had. The energy doesn't disappear — astrologers say it just waits. What's your rising sign? Drop it below.

candidates.teaser: Mercury retrograde gets blamed for everything — but almost nobody knows what's actually happening in the sky when it occurs.
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde Isn't What You Think It Is
candidates.video_description: Mercury doesn't actually move backward — it's a visual illusion created by orbital speeds. But in astrology, this apparent reversal has been interpreted for centuries as a period of miscommunication and reflection. The real story is stranger than the meme.
candidates.script: Mercury isn't actually moving backward — that's the part nobody tells you. It's an optical illusion caused by Earth overtaking Mercury in their orbits around the Sun, roughly three times a year. But here's where astrology gets interesting: ancient astrologers, centuries before modern astronomy, tracked this apparent reversal and consistently linked it to disrupted communication, delayed decisions, and revisited pasts. Whether coincidence or pattern, the archetype has held for thousands of years. Are you currently in a Mercury retrograde spiral? Tell me in the comments.

candidates.teaser: Over eight years, Venus draws a near-perfect five-pointed star across the sky — and ancient cultures built entire temples around it.
candidates.video_title: Venus Draws a Perfect Star in the Sky Every 8 Years
candidates.video_description: Venus completes a precise pentagram pattern relative to Earth every eight years — a cycle the ancient Mayans and Babylonians tracked obsessively. In astrology, Venus governs love and beauty, and many traditions saw this star pattern as sacred proof of its divine nature.
candidates.script: Venus traces a near-perfect five-pointed star across the sky — and it takes exactly eight years to complete it. The ancient Babylonians tracked this cycle obsessively. The Maya built entire temple alignments around Venus's movements. In astrology, Venus is the planet of love, beauty, and value — and for thousands of years, astrologers interpreted this geometric pattern as something almost intentional, a cosmic signature. Whether you see it as mathematics or meaning, the shape is real and it's stunning. Did you know Venus does this? Drop a star emoji if this blew your mind.

candidates.teaser: Most people only know their Sun sign — but astrologers say the sign you never check might reveal far more about who you actually are.
candidates.video_title: Your Moon Sign Knows You Better Than Your Star Sign
candidates.video_description: While your Sun sign reflects your outward identity, astrologers describe the Moon sign as the chart's emotional core — the part of you that emerges when no one is watching. Many people feel far more described by their Moon sign than the one they've known their whole lives.
candidates.script: You've known your star sign your whole life — but astrologers say it's actually the least personal part of your chart. Your Moon sign, determined by where the Moon was the exact moment you were born, is described in astrology as your emotional blueprint — how you process pain, what makes you feel safe, who you become when no one is watching. Most people look it up for the first time and feel genuinely seen in a way their Sun sign never managed. What's your Moon sign? Look it up and tell me if it fits.
